lede: The gondola project takes center stage Monday when the Gondola Leadership Committee meets for what looks like a substantive session — covering the CIG funding commitments, a project update, and background history listed as an action item, not just a recap. Close behind that, Parks and Recreation meets Wednesday at noon to revisit the already-approved paving of Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts, a project that's drawn more than 400 signatures in opposition — that's worth showing up for.
